original_requirement: Read exactly two byte flags for redundant safety sensors. Each flag must be 0 or 1. Validate the first flag before reading the second; validate the second next, then require the two flags to agree. Use FLAG_A, FLAG_B and DISAGREE respectively, located at the relevant flag (DISAGREE at the first). Return the first flag as UInt16BE. Perform trailing-data rejection last.
